title: GATv2-NS3 Hybrid IDS: Self-Focusing Simulations for Network Intrusion Detection

contributions.purpose: 用注意力不确定性驱动自适应仿真的 IDS
contributions.mechanism: GATv2 + NS-3;attention entropy 超自适应阈值时触发对模糊网络区域的聚焦 NS-3 仿真(Self-Focusing Simulations)
contributions.evaluation: 首次以 GATv2 注意力熵作为仿真保真度控制信号
contributions.domain: 网络入侵检测 / 图神经网络
contributions.source_quote: Self-Focusing Simulations: First application of GATv2 attention entropy as control signal for adaptive NS-3 simulation fidelity

contributions.purpose: 揭示严格评估下真实性能远低于常报值
contributions.mechanism: NSL-KDD/Cisco 上无泄漏评估协议
contributions.evaluation: 本方法 F1=0.711±0.015,传统 ~0.75,常报 >90%;严格评估给出更低但更诚实指标
contributions.source_quote: our method achieves F1=0.711 while traditional approaches reach F1≈0.75 on NSL-KDD

contributions.mechanism: 仅对高熵区域聚焦仿真而非均匀仿真
contributions.evaluation: 计算开销减少 40% 且维持检测质量
contributions.source_quote: The self-focusing mechanism reduces computational overhead by 40% compared to uniform simulation while maintaining detection quality.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This static formulation ignores network dynamics and lacks uncertainty quantification. We extend it to include adaptive simulation feedback

notes: 负结果/trade-off(诚实):本方法 F1=0.711 反而低于传统 ~0.75,论文主动坦承并将'现实评估更低但更诚实'作为核心贡献;精度优势不体现,卖点是评估诚实性 + 计算开销 -40%。数据说明:用 NS-3 合成攻击 + synthetic feedback(simulated baseline 语境),但作者主动披露而非掩饰。checklist 全 Yes 且列具体统计检验(paired t/Wilcoxon/McNemar/Friedman)。
